title: Rectangular Smith matrices over a DVR
statement: Let A be a commutative domain which is a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], and let pi generate its maximal ideal. Every n by m matrix F over A admits invertible L in GL(n,A), R in GL(m,A), a natural number r<=min(m,n), and a monotone e:Fin r -> Nat such that L F R has entry pi^(e i) for i=j<r and zero elsewhere. Moreover r=rank(F). Empty dimensions, r=0, and exponent-zero unit pivots are included.

source.place: Tag 00PD (DVR characterization); Mathlib LinearAlgebra/FreeModule/PID.lean, Submodule.smithNormalForm and Submodule.exists_smith_normal_form_of_le, for scalar Smith form. Agent rectangular-matrix basis calculation.

proof.text: Apply the scalar DVR Smith normal form to the image and split the source into kernel and lifted image bases. Express each nonzero coefficient as a unit times a power of the chosen uniformizer, absorb units into the codomain basis, and sort powers. The resulting basis matrices are invertible and give the displayed rectangular diagonal; the number of pivots is the matrix rank.

lean.statement: theorem exists_smith_pow {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] (π : A) (hπ : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A = Ideal.span {π}) (m n : ℕ) (F : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) A) : ∃ (L : GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) A) (R : GeneralLinearGroup (Fin m) A) (r : ℕ) (_hr : r ≤ min m n) (e : Fin r → ℕ) (D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) A), Monotone e ∧ (∀ (i : Fin n) (j : Fin m), D i j = if h : i.val = j.val ∧ i.val < r then π ^ e ⟨i.val, h.2⟩ else 0) ∧ r = F.rank ∧ (L : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) A) * F * (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) A) = D
